purpose: Document the publication routing terminology after the WLEP -> WELP rename. Future records say WELP; historical records that already say WLEP are not retroactively renamed.

github.holds: Frozen protocol + version history, test contracts, scoring scripts, benchmark harness/support scripts, schemas, hardware profiles, per-model manifests, environment records, command records, machine-readable summaries, execution counts, raw results where licensing permits, telemetry where useful, final reports, SHA256SUMS, reproduction instructions.
github.publishes_what: WELP snapshots (snapshot_id starts with welp-next-snapshot-); WELP contract IDs (welp- prefix); WELP schema names (welp_*.schema.json).
github.never_publishes: Model binaries, secrets/credentials, private/personal information, benchmark content whose license forbids redistribution.

wumbocore.holds: Model summary, performance, quality, reliability, context, coding, tools, charts, comparisons, verdict, recommended configuration, limitations, protocol version, links back to GitHub evidence and LocalMaxxing where present. Eventually generated/synchronized from canonical GitHub WELP Lab Records — do not create two independently maintained sources of truth.
wumbocore.language: WELP — WumboLabs Evaluation Lifecycle Protocol. Filenames: WELP-CONFORMANCE.md (new) or WLEP-CONFORMANCE.md (historical, not renamed).

localmaxxing.holds: Community-facing speed benchmarks, supported standardized benchmark shards/suites, and LocalMaxxing Reports (model-testing reports, exportable to X Articles).
localmaxxing.rules: Dry-run every submission first; fresh measurements only; never cherry-pick fastest repetitions; preserve submission/report IDs and lifecycle status; the LocalMaxxing Report derives from the SAME validated campaign evidence as the GitHub WELP Lab Record — no contradictory narratives. Early-stop campaigns that lack enough completed evidence record LOCALMAXXING_NOT_APPLICABLE with a reason instead of forcing a report.
localmaxxing.actual_x_posting: Separate human-authorized external action; never automated.

obsidian.holds: Workflow, phase definitions, gates, scoring methodology, repetition rules, early-stop rules, safety rules, agent operating rules, publication procedures, protocol-development rationale, unresolved questions, proposed changes, scoring issues.
filename_renames_during_wlep_to_welp_mig: Added new file: 'WumboLabs Evaluation Lifecycle Protocol (WELP).md' (canonical).
Retained legacy file: 'WumboLabs Model Evaluation Protocol (WLEP).md' (legacy alias).
WLEP Phase Structure.md kept as filename with WELP body content + Obsidian alias 'WELP Phase Structure' for forward compatibility.
obsidian.wikilink_resolution: All wikilinks either point to the new canonical file (WELP overview, WELP Phase Structure) or resolve via Obsidian alias declarations to legacy files.

forbidden: Renaming historical WLEP reports that already exist on GitHub or WumboCore to WELP.
Force-resubmitting LocalMaxxing reports to reflect a new protocol name; the existing report IDs and lifecycle statuses are preserved.
Altering historical Lab Record directory names like lab-records/<model>/wlep-<YYYY-MM-DD>/.
